'''Roon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the nearly impenetrable [[Cloak of the Sith/Legends|Cloak of the Sith]]. Known for its [[Roonstone]]s, the planet was constantly sought after by treasure hunters for [[Standard year/Legends|years]].

==Description==
Surrounded by a lethal [[Planetary ring/Legends|ring]] of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] and meteors, Roon was located in an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] of the [[Roon system/Legends|same name]]. It was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] with a diameter of 6,093 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] and standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. Its climate was [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]], and the surface was covered by [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], and plains. The planet's [[Standard year/Legends|year]] lasted 414 [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]], but as Roon was tidally-locked, it took a full year for it to rotate on its axis. The planet was orbited by a single [[Moon/Legends|moon]], and lay on the [[Death Wind Corridor/Legends|Death Wind Corridor]] and [[Manda-Roon Merchant Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]].<ref name="GATORW" />

Located in an impenetrable cosmic dust cloud ominously referred to as the [[Cloak of the Sith/Legends|Cloak of the Sith]], easily navigable routes to Roon had long been lost. Even the most complete accounts, located in the [[Baobab Archives]] on [[Manda/Legends|Manda]], were sketchy at best, and the loss of Roon's trading partners in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] upon its replacement by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] cut the system off fully from the rest of the galaxy.<ref name="GATORW" /> This was fine to native Roonians; the planet was plentiful in mineral resources, especially [[flame jewel]]s, [[roonstone]]s, and [[Roon spice]].<ref name="GATORW" />

Like nearby [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], Roon's tidal-locking rendered one side constantly bright and the other side constantly dark and cold, lit only by the moon and the [[rainbow comet]]s. Unlike Ryloth, however, the lit side of the world was not scorching, nor was the dark side frigid. Roon long served as a staging point for [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] coming from Ryloth.<ref name="GATORW" />

The way to Roon was rediscovered by explorer and treasure-hunter [[Mungo Baobab]]. In a move typical of his derring-do, Baobab followed the mysterious annual rainbow comet, a phenomenon that led him successfully through the Cloak of the Sith and near enough so that liberated prisoner [[Noop Yeldarb]] could guide him the remainder of the way. This became the [[Baobab Merchant Fleet]]-established [[Manda-Roon Merchant Route]], a replacement for the near-[[Death/Legends|suicidal]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]-charted [[Death Wind Corridor/Legends|Death Wind Corridor]] connected to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].

===Fauna===
Roon's fauna included a number of introduced species, including the [[Sentience/Legends|semisentient]] [[Mudman|mudmen]], [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]], [[Kalak/Legends|kalaks]], [[mogo]]s, [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]], and [[shamunaar]]. The mynocks performed an annual migration to Roon, a process that caused the planet's skies to darken.<ref name="GATORW" />

==History==
After being driven off of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Taung/Legends|Taungs]] fled to Roon, where they resided until [[7000 BBY]]. At this point, they immigrated to the planet that came to be known as [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="Gaw" />

Ancestors of Roon's later inhabitants first reached the planet around [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. During the prosperous years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], the world had a small but consistent level of trade with independent interests, importing necessary technologies and exporting [[flame jewel]]s, Roon [[Spice/Legends|spice]], and the occasional [[Roonstone]]s.<ref name="GATORW" /> Some time between [[42 BBY/Legends|42]] and [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Mahwi Lihnn]] took a bounty on Roon.

Roon remained withdrawn from the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] until [[15 BBY/Legends|15]] years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], when [[Bisad Koong|Koong]], [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Tawntoom]] province, contacted Admiral [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]]. Together, the two officials formed a loose and informal alliance to locate the cache of precious Roonstones. One of these Roonstones, which fell into the hands of [[Mungo Baobab]], contained the text of the the legendary poem, ''[[Dha Werda Verda]]'', which chronicled an ancient [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] battle between the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] and the [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]].

It was after Screed's interest in Roon that the planet finally began to become drawn into galactic affairs once more. A handful of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] groups managed to operate in the system, working with the natives of the [[Umboo]] province, a part of the planet known to have long opposed outside authority. It was through great efforts that Governor Koong tried again and again to subjugate this hardy people, but never to any avail. This was largely due to the efforts of Baobab, whose exploits on the world not only led to the discovery of the hidden Roonstone mines, but also to their subsequent destruction at the hands of the governor.

Largely thanks to its isolation, Roon remained untouched by the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==Inhabitants==
Roon was home to 665,000 residents, of whom 55% were [[Human/Legends|Human]] (primarily descended from exploratory or colonial missions), 12% were [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], 11% were [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], 7% were [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], 3% were [[Kobok/Legends|Kobok]], and 12% were members of other [[Species/Legends|species]]. These residents spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Bocce/Legends|Bocce]], and [[Durese/Legends|Durese]].<ref name="GATORW" />

Roonians were a hardy people who refused to discard archaic technologies if those techniques still worked. Thus, the resultant eclectic society placed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] alongside animal-driven labor and wooden boats.<ref name="GATORW" /> The planet's proximity to Ryloth resulted in a large Twi'lek population.

Most Roonians were content to mind their own business, even though most opposed the tyranny of Governor Koong during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. Because of their lack of resources, only the residents of the province of [[Umboo]] actively fought against him.<ref name="GATORW" />

Some of the population, who worked in the wet fields, were known as "the mudmen of Roon." Their name was occasionally invoked throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] when one felt dirty.

===Economy===
Roon's economy was butressed by the export of valuable flame jewels, roonstones, and spice. The [[Mining/Legends|mining]] of roonstones by off-worlders was forbidden in order to benefit Roon's economy and workforce. The planet's only major import was technology.<ref name="GATORW" />

===Government===
Until the rise of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Roon was ruled by a dictatorship. During the era of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the dictatorship aligned itself with the new [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government. After the New Republic rose to power, a representative democracy was established on the planet.<ref name="GATORW" />

==Locations==
Multiple [[City/Legends|cities]] were located along the coast of the [[Roon Sea]], a body of [[Water/Legends|water]]. Umboo Province was a beautiful area that was rich in resources.<ref name="GATORW" />
